about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Evoque D150 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Evoque D150 has been part of the Range Rover Evoque range since 2016, using the Ingenium family of 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engines. It replaced the earlier Ford-derived TD4 unit and brings modern common-rail diesel technology with a focus on efficiency and emissions compliance. The D150 is the entry-level diesel output in the Ingenium range, offering a balance of economy and everyday usability that suits the Evoque's character well. Land Rover Range Rover Evoque D150 Engine Codes Ingenium AJ150D / AJ200D (L538, L551) A 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the Evoque D150 from 2016 to present, spanning both the L538 and L551 generations. Known for timing chain tensioner wear, oil dilution from DPF regeneration, and EGR cooler leaks over time — see the callout above. We replace timing chains, injector seals, EGR components, and gaskets as standard on every D150 rebuild. The Evoque D150 uses the Ingenium AJ150D or AJ200D — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel. Both are part of the same Ingenium diesel family and share the same rebuild approach. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has. How much does a Land Rover Range Rover Evoque D150 engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £2,200, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote. Which engine code is fitted to my Evoque D150? Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the AJ150D or AJ200D before you're quoted anything. Do you rebuild Ingenium AJ150D Evoque D150 engines? Yes. We replace timing chains, injector seals, EGR components, and gaskets as standard on every AJ150D rebuild. Do you rebuild Ingenium AJ200D Evoque D150 engines? Yes. The AJ200D is the same engine family as the AJ150D, and we service it to the same standard, replacing timing chains, injector seals, EGR components, and gaskets. Do you supply used Range Rover Evoque D150 engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my Evoque D150 if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does an Evoque D150 engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Evoque D150 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Range Rover Evoque D150 from 2023 to present. The Ingenium AJ150D / AJ200D features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older Ingenium AJ150D / AJ200D V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every Ingenium AJ150D / AJ200D rebuild.
